Trump Goes to Asia
President Donald Trump’s Asia tour
kicks off today
in the Philippines. A series of talks on the sidelines of two regional summits will culminate in a three-way meeting with Russian President Vladimir Putin and Chinese President Xi Jinping on Thursday.
The US says the leaders will discuss nuclear nonproliferation: China is on track to possess more than 1,000 nuclear warheads by 2030, the Pentagon says; the US and Russia reportedly each have more than 5,000. The leaders will also discuss conflicts in Iran and Ukraine,
possibly in bilateral conversations. Critics of the summit, chief among them Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy, have likened it to the
1945 Yalta Conference
Looming over talks with Xi will be the end of a
semiconductor chip loophole
: The US said yesterday it will crack down on foreign data centers’ ability to lease US chips to adversaries, including China, amid fallout over the alleged Nvidia spy scandal (
see previous write-up
). Stocks of Nvidia and neocloud companies CoreWeave and Nebius dropped on the news, each by over 4%.

Batman Becomes Bond
British actor Robert Pattinson has been cast as the
next James Bond
, Amazon MGM Studios revealed yesterday. The announcement comes five years after Daniel Craig’s five-film arc wrapped with “No Time to Die.”
Pattinson shot to stardom in 2008 by portraying the leading love interest, Edward Cullen, in the hit vampire romance “Twilight” and its four sequels. Suiting up as 007 marks his second time headlining a legacy franchise, following his portrayal of Bruce Wayne in 2022's "The Batman" and its 2028 sequel. The Bond casting comes amid a blockbuster year for the 40-year-old actor that included high-profile roles in “The Odyssey," “Primetime,” and an upcoming villainous appearance in “Dune: Part Three” next month.
The Bond franchise sits as the fifth-highest-grossing series in cinema history, amassing roughly $7.7B globally across 25 official films (
who played the fictional spy before Pattinson
?). The 26th untitled Bond film has yet to receive a release date. In the meantime, see how to watch every previous Bond movie

Measles Elimination Lost
The Pan American Health Organization is expected to formally
revoke
the US' measles elimination status today. The decision comes as the US has recorded more than 5,400 measles cases so far this year, its highest annual total in more than three decades.
The US officially eliminated measles in 2000, following a decadeslong vaccination campaign (
see timeline
). The viral respiratory disease is considered eliminated when there has been no local, continuous transmission for at least 12 months (
why measles is highly contagious
, w/video). Experts largely agree that at least 95% of a population must be vaccinated to prevent outbreaks. Vaccination rates among US kindergarteners fell to 92.4% in the 2025-26 school year, down from 95.2% six years prior. Those rates and measles caseloads vary significantly by state;
scroll here for maps
Several other countries, including Canada and the UK, have also lost their elimination status in the past two years amid declining vaccination rates. See which countries do and don't have elimination status
here
